info.title: GriipBuddy API
info.description:
Generated from the Express routes and their Zod schemas (`npm run docs`).

**Log in**, copy `access_token`, click **Authorize** and paste it.
Every response is `{ statusCode, success, message, data, meta? }`; errors add `errorMessages[]`.
File fields hold short paths like `uploads/<id>.jpg` — the frontend adds the file base URL.

get.description: 🌐 Public. 200 when the database answers, 503 otherwise.

post.description:
🌐 Public.

Returns `access_token`, `refresh_token` and the user. Use the access token with **Authorize**.

patch.description:
🔒 Any logged-in **staff** member.

Needs the current password. Returns new tokens; other devices are logged out.

🌐 Public.

Unknown numbers get the same reply. Outside production the code is returned as `dev_otp`.

🔒 **Staff** with permission `user.update`.

Sending `password` also logs them out everywhere.

🔒 **Staff** with permission `user.update`.

delete.summary: Delete a user (soft delete; the phone number is freed)

post.summary: Send a login code by SMS
post.description:
🌐 Public.

1 code per minute, 5 per hour per number; expires in 5 minutes. Outside production (or with `OTP_STATIC_CODE`) see `dev_otp`.

🌐 Public.

Creates the account on first login and links earlier orders with this phone. 5 wrong tries cancel the code.

🔒 Logged-in **customer** (phone + OTP login).

Each order has `payment_status`: PAID, PARTIAL, VERIFYING or UNPAID.

Create a purchase (status `received` adds the stock)

post.description:
🌐 Public.

Prices and totals are recalculated on the server; stock is reserved.

patch.description:
🔒 **Staff** with permission `order.update`.

Moves stock (reserve / ship / release) and may SMS the customer.

put.description:
🔒 **Staff** with permission `cms.create` or `cms.update`.

Items with `_id` are updated, new ones added, missing ones removed.

bearerAuth.description: The `access_token` from a login (staff: POST /user/admin/login, customer: POST /customer/otp/verify).

Success.description: Success (200, or 201 when something was created)

Unauthorized.description: Not logged in, or the token expired / was logged out
